integrity: Exact proof with two reproducibility scripts; prior-work comparison was literature-based, not a claim of exhaustive novelty.
scientific_limitations: The complete-split family only; no general split-graph theorem or shortest-path diameter for the induced simple locus. Equivalent unindexed historical results are a possibility. Finite tests do not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: Vertex-degree distribution and connected simple stratum of complete-split graphical zonotopes
